items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: do you know Allan McMillan the great…

ctx.x: Yeah. They are custodians of it. But I don‟t know where all that money went because I do know that… this guy that we all disliked because he was a terror was Joe Glazier. I knew his… [unintelligible]. And Joe Glazier was a pimp, one of the pimps that hung around there. And there were stories that he went to jail about that. When he came out his mother told him, take this boy and work with him. And that‟s how he4 got with Louie. They never had a contract. And he died, he really did what he said he was going to do…
